custom_fields.name: loopback_ip
custom_fields.label: BGP loopback IPv4
custom_fields.description: e.g. 10.255.255.1/32. Announced in OSPF, used as iBGP and router id

custom_fields.name: bgp_primary
custom_fields.label: Primary BGP node
custom_fields.description: Exactly one device. Deployed first, originates the own prefixes

custom_fields.name: hub
custom_fields.label: Hub transit router
custom_fields.description: IX routers: device name of the transit router they tunnel to

custom_fields.name: short_name
custom_fields.label: Short name
custom_fields.description: Up to 11 characters, used in the gre-<short> interface name

custom_fields.name: mesh_ip
custom_fields.label: Cloudflare Mesh IP
custom_fields.description: Filled in by the cloudflare_mesh role

custom_fields.name: rpki_validator
custom_fields.label: Runs the RPKI validator
custom_fields.description: Default: transit routers

custom_fields.name: rpki_rtr
custom_fields.label: RPKI RTR servers
custom_fields.description: Optional override, comma separated host:port

custom_fields.name: originate_prefixes
custom_fields.label: Originate own prefixes
custom_fields.description: Default: the primary node only

custom_fields.name: use_mesh
custom_fields.label: On the Cloudflare Mesh
custom_fields.description: Default: transit routers and monitoring yes, IX routers no. Two mesh nodes get a second (mesh) GRE tunnel

custom_fields.name: gre_endpoint
custom_fields.label: GRE endpoint IPv4
custom_fields.description: Public address for direct GRE tunnels. Default: the device's primary IPv4

custom_fields.name: ipv6_block
custom_fields.label: IPv6 /48
custom_fields.description: Unique /48 for this VM, inside OWN-V6, e.g. 2001:db8:1234::/48. Its first /64 is the management network

custom_fields.name: mgmt_parent
custom_fields.label: Management parent
custom_fields.description: For a VM inside an IX: device name of the IX router whose management /64 it uses

custom_fields.name: mgmt_ipv6
custom_fields.label: Management IPv6
custom_fields.description: Address inside the parent's management /64 (required with mgmt_parent)

custom_fields.name: bgp_password
custom_fields.label: BGP password
custom_fields.description: Only if the plugin has no password field

custom_fields.name: max_prefix
custom_fields.label: Max prefixes
custom_fields.description: Overrides the class default

custom_fields.name: irr_as_set
custom_fields.label: IRR as-set
custom_fields.description: Default: AS<remote asn>

custom_fields.name: allow_private_as
custom_fields.label: Allow private ASNs in paths
custom_fields.description: Needed for the Vultr session (AS64515)

custom_fields.name: neighbor_interface
custom_fields.label: Neighbor interface
custom_fields.description: Adds a static route to the neighbor via this interface (Vultr link-local style neighbors)

custom_fields.name: import_prefix_list
custom_fields.label: Static import prefix list
custom_fields.description: Name of a netbox_bgp prefix list that overrides the IRR filter

custom_fields.name: anycast_originate
custom_fields.label: Originate anycast prefixes
custom_fields.description: Router announces every IPAM prefix tagged bgp-anycast (set on both transits)

custom_fields.name: anycast_prepend
custom_fields.label: Anycast prepends
custom_fields.description: Extra prepends on anycast prefixes only, 0-5

custom_fields.name: anycast_communities
custom_fields.label: Anycast communities
custom_fields.description: Comma separated standard (a:b) or large (a:b:c) communities added to anycast prefixes only, e.g. 20473:6001:3356

custom_fields.name: path_asn
custom_fields.label: AS seen in paths
custom_fields.description: The AS that appears next to ours in paths (Vultr: 20473, since the session is AS64515)
